body.statement: For every deterministic finite grid and \(0<\alpha<1\), conditional Hoeffding inequalities within each nonempty treatment--covariate cell and the unconditional Hoeffding inequalities for \(\widehat p_x\) give \(\inf_P\Pr_P(\mathscr E_n)\ge1-\alpha\). On the single simultaneous event \(\mathscr E_n\), arm-specific independent censoring implies that the true coarsened primitive vector satisfies \(g^{zx}_{i+1}\pi^{zx}_{ij}\le A^{zx}_{ij}\le g^{zx}_i\pi^{zx}_{ij}\), \(Y^{zx}_i=g^{zx}_i\{\sum_{h\ge i,j}\pi^{zx}_{hj}+\sum_j\pi^{zx}_{\infty j}\}\), \(V^{zx}_j=g^{zx}_m\pi^{zx}_{\infty j}\), and \(1\ge g^{zx}_0\ge\cdots\ge g^{zx}_m\ge\gamma\); hence it belongs to \(\mathcal B_n\) and deterministically \(\Theta_I(P)|_{\mathcal G_m}\subseteq\mathcal C_n\). Therefore \(\inf_P\Pr_P\{\Theta_I(P)|_{\mathcal G_m}\subseteq\mathcal C_n\}\ge1-\alpha\). The result uses sample size \(n\) for \(p_x\), assigns \([0,1]\) to every primitive interval in a zero-count cell, and remains valid at every change of the active flow face.
body.justification: A face-robust finite-sample guard is the honest fallback wherever the sharp endpoint map is nondifferentiable and ordinary multiplier calibration is invalid.
body.gap: Goldberg controls individual IPCW averages and Cho--Russell give asymptotic perturbed-LP inference; neither propagates one joint censoring-moment event through every nested-survivor surface face.
body.consumer: It provides conservative but auditable uncertainty sets for the finite clinical horizon grid even when active cuts tie.
